_comment: Octail curated egg (plan §6.4). Based on games-steamcmd the_forest/egg-pterodactyl-the-forest.json (pelican-eggs, MIT licence) at 8dd208975977aa24a6c53008a65a630c150806b8. Octail fixes the config edits ({{server.environment.X}} instead of {{server.build.env.X}}, keys matched with their trailing space so serverPassword doesn't also replace serverPasswordAdmin), writes a first config.cfg only when there is none (upstream overwrote it on every reinstall) and makes sure each key it sets has a line, moves the admin password from the command line into config.cfg and makes it optional (upstream: a fixed default), gives the query and Steam ports their own automatic ports (port_vars) instead of fixed 27016 and 8766, starts with initType Continue (the save in the slot, a new game when there is none; upstream: New), adds the save slot and autosave interval, the the-forest tag, the no_console_input flag, the Steam query (A2S) for player counts, install sandbox defaults and resource hints, port readiness (x_octail.features.ready) besides the autosave line, starts with the image's Xvfb instead of xvfb-run and filters the RenderTexture warnings without hiding the server's process, stops with Ctrl+C handed to the server by a trap (the wine image runs the line in bash as PID 1, which ignores it otherwise) and waits for it, drops the hidden WINEDEBUG/WINEARCH variables (the image sets them), and makes the install fail when SteamCMD didn't download the server. SteamCMD is retried up to 3 times: its first run on a fresh install often fails with "Missing configuration".
name: The Forest
author: admin@softwarenoob.com
description: Survive a plane crash in a forest full of cannibals: build, explore and hold out together. The Windows dedicated server, run under Wine.

startup_commands.Default: export SteamAppId=242760; wine ./TheForestDedicatedServer.exe -batchmode -nographics -nosteamclient -savefolderpath /home/container/TheForestDedicatedServer_Data/Saves/ -configfilepath /home/container/TheForestDedicatedServer_Data/forest/config/config.cfg > >(grep --line-buffered -v 'RenderTexture.Create failed') 2>&1 & FOREST_PID=$!; trap "kill -INT ${FOREST_PID} 2>/dev/null; wait ${FOREST_PID}" INT TERM; wait ${FOREST_PID}

installation.script:
#!/bin/bash
## Octail curated install: SteamCMD downloads the Windows build of the server (it runs under Wine).
## Server Files: /mnt/server

## just in case someone removed the defaults.
if [[ "${STEAM_USER}" == "" ]] || [[ "${STEAM_PASS}" == "" ]]; then
    echo -e "steam user is not set.\n"
    echo -e "Using anonymous user.\n"
    STEAM_USER=anonymous
    STEAM_PASS=""
    STEAM_AUTH=""
else
    echo -e "user set to ${STEAM_USER}"
fi

## download and install steamcmd
cd /tmp
mkdir -p /mnt/server/steamcmd
curl -fsSL -o steamcmd.tar.gz https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/client/installer/steamcmd_linux.tar.gz || { echo "Downloading SteamCMD failed."; exit 1; }
tar -xzvf steamcmd.tar.gz -C /mnt/server/steamcmd
mkdir -p /mnt/server/steamapps # Fix steamcmd disk write error when this folder is missing
cd /mnt/server/steamcmd

# SteamCMD fails otherwise for some reason, even running as root.
# This is changed at the end of the install process anyways.
chown -R root:root /mnt
export HOME=/mnt/server

## install game using steamcmd
## Octail: SteamCMD's first run often fails with "Missing configuration"; try up to 3 times
for steamcmd_try in 1 2 3; do
    if ./steamcmd.sh +force_install_dir /mnt/server +login ${STEAM_USER} ${STEAM_PASS} ${STEAM_AUTH} $( [[ "${WINDOWS_INSTALL}" == "1" ]] && printf %s '+@sSteamCmdForcePlatformType windows' ) +app_update ${SRCDS_APPID} $( [[ -z ${SRCDS_BETAID} ]] || printf %s "-beta ${SRCDS_BETAID}" ) $( [[ -z ${SRCDS_BETAPASS} ]] || printf %s "-betapassword ${SRCDS_BETAPASS}" ) ${INSTALL_FLAGS} validate +quit; then break; fi
    echo "SteamCMD did not finish (attempt $steamcmd_try of 3)"
done

## set up 32 bit libraries
mkdir -p /mnt/server/.steam/sdk32
cp -v linux32/steamclient.so ../.steam/sdk32/steamclient.so

## set up 64 bit libraries
mkdir -p /mnt/server/.steam/sdk64
cp -v linux64/steamclient.so ../.steam/sdk64/steamclient.so

## Octail: fail the install when SteamCMD didn't download the server
if [[ ! -f "/mnt/server/TheForestDedicatedServer.exe" ]]; then
    echo -e "\nSteamCMD failed to install The Forest dedicated server; try reinstalling."
    exit 1
fi

## Octail: the server reads TheForestDedicatedServer_Data/forest/config/config.cfg (-configfilepath). A first one
## is written here; an existing one is kept. Every line Octail sets before each start ("key value", the file parser
## matches "key ") must be there, so a key that is missing or has no value yet gets a line of its own.
CFG_DIR=/mnt/server/TheForestDedicatedServer_Data/forest/config
CFG="${CFG_DIR}/config.cfg"
mkdir -p "${CFG_DIR}" /mnt/server/TheForestDedicatedServer_Data/Saves
if [[ ! -f "$CFG" ]]; then
    cat > "$CFG" <<'EOF'
// The Forest dedicated server settings, written by the Octail install.
// The Startup tab sets the ports, name, players, passwords, Steam account token, VAC, difficulty, start type,
// save slot and autosave interval before every start. The rest can be edited here with the server stopped.
serverIP 0.0.0.0
serverSteamPort 8766
serverGamePort 27015
serverQueryPort 27016
serverName Octail The Forest Server
serverPlayers 8
serverPassword
serverPasswordAdmin
serverSteamAccount
enableVAC off
serverAutoSaveInterval 15
difficulty Normal
initType Continue
slot 1
showLogs off
serverContact
veganMode off
vegetarianMode off
resetHolesMode off
treeRegrowMode off
allowBuildingDestruction on
allowEnemiesCreativeMode off
allowCheats off
realisticPlayerDamage off
saveFolderPath
targetFpsIdle 5
targetFpsActive 60
EOF
fi
for key in serverIP serverSteamPort serverGamePort serverQueryPort serverName serverPlayers serverPassword \
    serverPasswordAdmin serverSteamAccount enableVAC serverAutoSaveInterval difficulty initType slot; do
    if grep -qE "^${key}( |$)" "$CFG"; then
        sed -i -E "s/^${key}$/${key} /" "$CFG"
    else
        echo "${key} " >> "$CFG"
    fi
done

## install end
echo "-----------------------------------------"
echo "Installation completed..."
echo "-----------------------------------------"

variables.name: Server Name
variables.description: The name in the server list (no double quotes or backslashes). Written to config.cfg.

variables.name: Server Password
variables.description: Optional: players must enter it to join. Empty = no password (no spaces, quotes or backslashes).

variables.name: Admin Password
variables.description: Optional: the password for the in-game admin commands. Empty = nobody can log in as admin.

variables.name: Max Players
variables.description: How many players may join at once (The Forest allows 8).

variables.name: Start Type
variables.description: Continue loads the save in the save slot (a new game when there is none); New starts a new game in it.

variables.name: Save Slot
variables.description: The save slot (1 to 5) the server loads and saves.

variables.name: Steam Account Token
variables.description: Optional: a Steam game server login token for app 242760 (steamcommunity.com/dev/managegameservers). Without one the server runs anonymously and players' progress on it may not be kept.

variables.name: Query Port
variables.description: Steam query port (UDP), for the server list. Set by Octail when the server is created (the port after the game port).

variables.name: Steam Port
variables.description: Steam communication port (UDP). Set by Octail when the server is created (two after the game port).

variables.name: Auto Update
variables.description: Update the server with SteamCMD before every start (1 = on, 0 = off).

variables.name: Windows Install
variables.description: Downloads the Windows build (the server runs under Wine).
